5.​ Add after paragraph 31 and renumber (Cardiff 2) 
 
Retention also requires mentorship from the leadership in the branches. A contact is 
not a comrade after setting up subs or passing probation, they will need to be 
constantly convinced of our tactics and methods and mentorship can really solidify 
newer members and help them not cave in to outside pressures. This will also help 
them take on the work fully and get over any personal hang ups, like calling contacts, 
if the leadership is leading by example. 
 
CC recommendation: Reject
